title: InSight: Self-Guided Skill Acquisition via Steerable VLAs
abstract: arXiv:2606.24884v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models excel at robot manipulation via imitation learning, but adapting them to new tasks often requires additional human demonstrations, which can be costly or infeasible. Meanwhile, vision-language models (VLMs) offer semantic task understanding but lack the physical grounding required for execution. To bridge this gap, we present InSight, a framework for self-guided skill acquisition that uses a VLM to identify primitives missing from a VLA's repertoire, grounds the VLM's proposals through robot execution, and distills new primitives from successful rollouts into the VLA. Primitive steerability, the ability to execute and terminate primitives on command, enables the robot to reuse known primitives while collecting training data for missing primitives without requiring full-task human demonstrations for each new task. InSight has two stages: (1) a VLM automatically segments existing demonstrations

translated_title: InSight：基于可引导视觉-语言-动作模型的自引导技能习得
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过模仿学习在机器人操作任务中表现出色，但将其适应到新任务通常需要额外的人类示范，这可能成本高昂或不可行。与此同时，视觉-语言模型（VLM）具备语义层面的任务理解能力，但缺乏执行所需的物理落地能力。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了InSight，一个自引导技能习得框架：它利用VLM识别VLA技能库中缺失的基元，通过机器人执行将VLM的提议落地，并将成功执行轨迹中的新基元蒸馏到VLA中。基元可引导性，即按命令执行和终止基元的能力，使机器人能够在为缺失基元收集训练数据的同时复用已知基元，而无需为每个新任务提供完整任务的人类示范。InSight包含两个阶段：（1）VLM自动分割现有示范……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: InSight框架利用VLM识别VLA技能库中缺失的基元并通过机器人执行将其落地，再将成功轨迹蒸馏回VLA，借助基元可引导性实现无需完整人类示范的自引导技能习得。
en_tdlr: InSight is a self-guided skill acquisition framework that uses a VLM to identify primitives missing from a VLA's repertoire, grounds them through robot execution, and distills successful rollouts back into the VLA, enabling adaptation to new tasks without full-task human demonstrations.
